'''Powster15 Chewie's Angels''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Powster15]]
* '''Published:''' 4 January 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor: Back Door|Endor-L-endorbackdoor.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Endor: Back Door
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor Endor Back Door Powster15 LS 2002.txt |Download]]

"Rhoooaaaarrhh Rhooar Roor!!!"...."Good morning, Chewie!"  Chewie sends his Angels on a difficult mission to Endor to destroy the shield generators!

The published list has 58 cards.

== Strategy ==

Most of the advantages are focused around Chewie and Leia.  Protector allows them an advantage fighting together.  They each have weapons geared for them (Sporting Blaster and Bowcaster).

Starships get attention from the pilots given (Leia, Leslomy, Chewie, Mirax, Toryn, and Thaneespi).  They may add their expertise to the Naboo Starfighters (and the Skate for Mirax).  Thaneespi boosts the Defiance's defenses with her Turbolasers.  Her game text works with Ackbar (sort of the Bosley of the operation :-).

Oola and Jess will charm the pants off any males that may come their way.

Hoth is protected by the shields, the Defiance, and the ion cannon, operated by Toryn.

Shmi and Mothma subtract from battle destiny both on land and in the air.

The deck gives advantages to each Angels' individual prowess, while also giving them a chance to work together.  This is just a rough draft, so any positive criticism would be appreciated.
